rows.grounds: compound of twilight, portion, and measure; accusative singular neuter
gerundive of root jñā, to be known

items.question: What measure of the twilight portion is knowable?
premises: Ten thousand years are thus described.
The twilight portion measure is knowable.
items.inference: The twilight portion measure should be known.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of sandhyaṃśamānam remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Thus ten thousand years; the measure of the twilight portion is to be known.
